settings.subtitle: The living-room study chair that grows from age five to ten - a switchable body changes the height with one lever, no tools, and a footrest keeps posture steady.

settings.heading: SIDIZ TREVO Kids Chair for the Living-Room Study and Dining Table
settings.body:
• Switchable body - flip the body with a lever, no tools, to change the height as your child grows from five to ten.
  • A steady footrest - supports the legs, spreads the load, and stops dangling feet from breaking concentration.
  • Minimal design, easy upkeep - a clean look that suits living and dining spaces, in stain-resistant plastic made for shared rooms.

A lasting living-room study chair that flexes with your child's growth at the dining table.

settings.subtitle: My first learning mate
settings.heading: TREVO
settings.alt: A child learning at the table in the SIDIZ TREVO
settings.description:
Where living-and-dining learning with your child begins: the TREVO is a growth-fitted living-room study chair, made new again each day as your child grows.

A first step into good study habits and posture - a chair that adjusts with growth and lasts, the perfect learning mate for every moment of discovery.

settings.subheading:
The habit of focus begins in the living room -
a living study, face to face with you
settings.description: At the age when curious questions turn into learning, a child's first study space should not be a closed room but the living table, sharing eye contact with a parent. The TREVO turns the living room into the best learning-mate space your child could have.
settings.alt: A parent and child learning together at the living table

settings.title: Designed to living-table height
settings.description: SIDIZ's ergonomic fit, built from a precise study of the body balance of children aged five to ten as they read and learn at dining and living tables.
settings.alt: The TREVO matched to living-table height

settings.title: A slim silhouette that never blocks the view
settings.description: Dining chair and study chair in one, in a minimal, refined design that soaks into the space without disturbing the interior.
settings.alt: The TREVO's slim silhouette at the table

settings.title: A backrest handle hole that adds convenience
settings.description: A handle hole in the backrest makes the TREVO easy to carry between the spaces it serves.
settings.alt: Carrying the TREVO by its handle hole

settings.title: A cushioned seat cover, comfortable and easy to keep
settings.description: Comfortable through long sittings, in neutral colours that warm the room, wrapping the seat as if part of the chair. *Sold separately.
settings.alt: Fitting the TREVO seat cushion cover

settings.heading: Easy growing, no tools needed
settings.description: Matched to how fast children grow between five and ten, the TREVO switches between two modes with a lever alone - no tools - so the fit stays right and the study posture stays optimal as your child changes. *HIGH SITTING MODE: ages 5-7, chair and footrest at the higher setting. *LOW SITTING MODE: ages 8-10, chair and footrest at the lower setting.
settings.alt: The TREVO switching between its two sitting modes

settings.title: A switchable body that flips front to back
settings.description: Switch the body forward or back and the height changes - growing made simple.
settings.alt: Flipping the TREVO's switchable body

settings.title: A footrest matched to each mode
settings.description: The footrest follows the chair's height so a child holds a stable, upright posture in either mode.

settings.title: HIGH SITTING MODE: ages 5-7
settings.description: Chair and footrest sit higher for smaller children still growing into the table.
settings.alt: The TREVO in high sitting mode

settings.title: LOW SITTING MODE: ages 8-10
settings.description: Chair and footrest sit lower for school-age children who have grown.
settings.alt: The TREVO in low sitting mode

settings.title: A material that shrugs off stains and scratches
settings.description: Liquids do not soak in and the scratch-resistant plastic holds its finish through the busiest play, keeping upkeep simple.
settings.alt: Wiping the TREVO clean

settings.title: A removable cover that washes separately
settings.description: The optional cushion separates into sponge and cover, so the cover washes easily. *Sold separately.
settings.alt: Removing the TREVO cushion cover

settings.title: Soft, rounded curves that prevent knocks
settings.description: Every element, footrest included, is rounded so curious children stay safe whatever they get up to.
settings.alt: The TREVO's rounded edges

settings.title: Certified as a children's product
settings.description: The TREVO holds Korea's supplier-conformity certification for children's products, issued by an accredited body.
settings.alt: The TREVO's children's product certification

settings.heading: Everyday care made simpler, safety made surer

settings.title: ATTI
settings.description: For toddlers spending their first hours at a desk, forming posture habits. Recommended: 18 months to age 5.
settings.alt: The SIDIZ ATTI toddler chair

settings.title: TREVO
settings.description: For children studying with a parent at the living table. Recommended: ages 5-10, height 110-140 cm.
settings.alt: The SIDIZ TREVO growing high chair

settings.title: RINGO
settings.description: For primary students beginning self-directed study in their own room. Recommended: age 7 to primary school, height 110-160 cm.
settings.alt: The SIDIZ RINGO kids chair

settings.title: IBLE
settings.description: For secondary students who need unshakeable focus at the desk. Recommended: secondary school and up, height 160 cm and above.
settings.alt: The SIDIZ IBLE study chair

settings.title: Washing the cushion cover
settings.body: Wash gently at 40 degrees. No oxygen bleach. Iron between 80 and 120 degrees if needed. No dry cleaning. Dry flat, in the shade.
settings.alt: Cushion cover washing guidance

settings.title: Removing stains from the frame
settings.body: If the frame gets marked during assembly or use, a melamine sponge lifts stains easily. *Rubbing hard can damage the surface.
settings.alt: Cleaning the TREVO frame

settings.question: Up to what age can the TREVO be used?
settings.answer: The recommended height range is 100 to 140 cm - designed around standard child growth data to suit roughly ages 5 to 10, though every child grows at their own pace.

settings.question: Can an adult sit in it?
settings.answer: The TREVO's maximum load is 80 kg - please keep weight in mind when it is used.

settings.question: Does changing modes need any tools?
settings.answer: No - the body switches front to back with the lever alone, and the footrest follows the chair's height in each mode.
